title: [DOC2-2] Relay guide says a relay cannot suspend a token
description: Review finding DOC2-2: Relay guide says a relay cannot suspend a token (lens DOC2). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:1060, :2373, §17.2 table (:2365-2371), metric `cause` labels (:1195); spec/10-relays.md:642; spec/11-transport.md:188. Fix: The guide says "There is no admin operation that suspends or blocks a token" and "The relay has no control that blocks a single token". Spec §10.4.7 says "A Relay MAY stop admitting ... for one registered `channelToken` ... MUST notify the CO", and §11.4 lists suspension as a `token-withdrawn` cause. Apply the reviewer's fix as written: add a suspend/lift admin operation, a §17.2 row, a `suspended` cause label and the mandatory `contact` notice, and delete both "no control" sentences. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
